anchors.event_window_plain: After the US close on Wednesday 2 September 2026 through before the US open on Thursday 3 September 2026
anchors.spot_as_of: 2026-09-02, WebSearch snippet (aggregator quote, -2.54% intraday), refreshed same-day; stage-2 spot was $319.80 as of 2026-09-01T20:00Z prior close. Several personas independently sourced spot drifting lower intraday (~$306-310) as the session progressed toward the print.
anchors.implied_move_as_of: 2026-09-02, refreshed same-day; stage-2 value was 12.94% as of 2026-09-01
anchors.historical_moves_ordering_caveat: Supplied to personas as 'most recent last'; per five personas' independent sourcing this list is actually ordered most-recent-first (36.48% = 2026-05-27 Q1 FY27, the most recent print). Order does not affect synthesize.py's aggregate statistics.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Implied ±12% sits below the 17%/14% mean/median realised; models 13-16% realised. Bar is above the guide: buy-side wants product revenue >$1.46B, NRR near 126%, and an FY27 guide raise to 32-33%; a guide-only beat does not clear it.
key_drivers: Forward KPIs lean positive: RPO +38% YoY to $9.21B (above product revenue growth), NRR 126% company record, 779 $1M+ customers +29%, four straight beats ~22% avg surprise
Valuation/quality is the offset: ~16x forward revenue, ~120-160x forward EPS after +47-50% YTD, GAAP op loss $326M, SBC ~31% of revenue -- a beat is already required just to hold flat
Classic post-blowout trap risk: a normal 3% guide beat with FY27 raised only modestly (34%->~33% growth) reads as deceleration and compresses the multiple even on a fine quarter
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Second derivative of growth (34%->33%) matters more than the beat itself; 30 days of zero upward EPS revision suggests sell-side enthusiasm is in price targets, not numbers
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: 60/90-day revision breadth unavailable; no sourced buy-side whisper for the exact FY27 guide number

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Front expiry prices ~12-12.9%, below the 14%/17% median/mean realised; straddle is fair-to-cheap, not rich. Realised move likely 13-18%.
key_drivers: Flow is crowded-bullish and speculative: calls 2.57x puts, biggest prints are capped-risk call spreads; downside skew rose 1.80pp to 2.68 into the event -- institutions paying up for protection while retail buys calls
Dealer mechanics tilt near-term asymmetry down: positive-gamma regime with call wall $340, put wall $300, gamma flip $292; spot has bled to ~$306-310, now sitting near the put wall

No squeeze fuel and a maximally extended consensus: short interest only 5.58% of float, down from prior period -- shorts already covered into the rally; stock +48% YTD with everything bullish already in the price
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Base rate is against this call (6 of 8 prior reactions positive) and the stock has already de-risked ~7% over two sessions, lowering the bar into the print
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Borrow fee unavailable; Phase-0 history list appears ordered most-recent-first, not last -- OptionSlam confirms 2026-05-27 (+36.48%) was the most recent print

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect ~13-15% realised; ±12% implied is slightly cheap on magnitude. Direction close to a coin flip with a modest downward tilt; the mispricing is in magnitude, not sign.
key_drivers: Crowded consensus long: 44 of 51 analysts at Buy with a wave of pre-print target raises, yet the average target sits only ~3.7% above spot -- sell-side chasing, not leading, at ~16x forward revenue

Tone/flow divergence: social tone extremely bullish but tracked retail portfolios show NET DIVESTING (-1.7% 7-day, -2.4% 30-day); options show calls 2.57x puts on volume while downside skew widens -- talk bullish, money and hedges leaving
Underlying demand signal is real (CoCo at 7,100+ enterprise accounts fastest-ever ramp, 11,000+ customers, NRR 126%), which is why this is a lean and not a short
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Base rate flatly opposes: up after 6 of 8 prints, beaten consensus 4 of 4 with ~22% avg surprise, short interest near a company high -- a beat-and-raise squeezes shorts and the crowded-long condition becomes fuel instead of a warning
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No clean social-volume delta for the specific pre-print window; crowding read rests on sell-side target-vs-spot, options skew and portfolio flows rather than direct social-volume measurement

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% implied looks fairly priced to marginally cheap; central expectation ±11-14%, fat negative skew. Directional base rate up-tilted (6/8, 86% of last 7) but three tail-up prints all launched from depressed bases -- this print launches from a 52-week high, so the magnitude distribution should compress.
key_drivers: Directional base rate genuinely up-tilted but thin: 6 up / 2 down in 8 sourced quarters; extending to 12 quarters with looser sourcing degrades to ~67%

Conditional cohort cuts the other way: SNOW's two clearest sell-the-news prints both followed multi-month run-ups (like now, +49% YTD, +90% over six months, fresh 52-week high hours before the report); the three tail-up prints followed drawdowns
Gap-and-drift has been continuation, not fade, in the traceable observations -- direction of the first move has mattered more than mean reversion
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The 52-week-high run-in dominates: a high-multiple consumption name at a fresh high needs a beat-and-raise materially above whisper just to hold flat, and SNOW has twice taken a double-digit hit on an in-line-but-not-heroic guide from a similar setup
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Pre-Aug-2023 reactions and drift decomposition unsourced (blocked sources); 4 drift observations are inferred, not measured. Phase-0 list appears most-recent-first, not last -- flagged, not used in ordering

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% implied is modestly cheap against 14%/17% median/mean realised; expect realised >=12%, skewed down. Direction is not priced in; magnitude is roughly fairly-to-slightly-under priced.
key_drivers: Nearest comps punished on beat-and-raise: MongoDB beat and raised yet fell ~13-14%; Datadog beat and raised yet fell 15.6-21% -- both consumption-model data infra, both extended into the print, exactly SNOW's setup (+47% YTD, zero valuation cushion vs consensus PT)
Duration-hostile cross-asset regime on event day: 10y at 4.79%, 30y near 2007 highs, ~66-68% odds of a Fed hike on Sept 16; ISM Services and payrolls land inside the reaction window

Genuine offset: hyperscaler cloud read-through is outstanding (Azure +43%, AWS +37%, GCP +82%) and the late-Aug software tape paid huge premiums for clean AI-benefit stories (CRM, CRWD, OKTA all +15-29% on beats) -- a strong tilt, not a dominant override
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: SNOW is the cohort's designated AI-consumption winner, not a victim; an accelerating print above the FY27 $5.84B guide squeezes a short base in the same configuration that produced +36% in May 2026
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No SNOW-specific buyside whisper or ETF/index flow figure sourced; short-interest figures snippet_only and disagree by source (5.47% vs 6.4%). Phase-0 ordering appears inconsistent -- May 2026 (+36%) matches the list's first entry, not its last

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect a realised move larger than ±12% implied -- median of the 8 prints is 14.05%, mean 16.97%, and the last two AI-narrative prints were +36% and +32.7%. Straddle looks cheap on magnitude; direction close to a coin-flip with a modest upward tilt.
panel_verdicts.strongest_reversal_case: A beat-and-raise that sells off, because the buyside bar is far above the sell-side bar and the multiple has no cushion (~16x forward revenue vs IGV 7.7x). Specific trigger: Q1 was rewarded for accelerating to 34%, but Q2 is guided to ~30% -- even a solid beat reads as deceleration. KeyBanc survey work cited in previews shows enterprises planning to use LLMs to reduce Snowflake spend, attacking the consumption model directly. Insiders sold ~$322M last quarter including Slootman cutting direct holdings ~90% on Aug 18-20, and the stock was already rolling over into the print (-3.00% Aug 24, -3.66% Aug 25, -2.54% on print day).
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: A Q3 guide implying ~33%+ growth with another FY27 raise materially above $5.84B -- no deceleration to point at -- would let the short base and record institutional buying force a squeeze through the 52-week high
key_drivers: Bar problem: Q2 guide of ~30% product growth vs Q1's celebrated 34% acceleration means a beat can still read as deceleration
No valuation cushion -- ~16x forward revenue vs IGV 7.7x, SBC ~35% of revenue, $1.33B FY26 GAAP loss give bears an easy handle
Positioning is two-sided: heavy insider distribution (Slootman) against thin short float and record institutional accumulation -- fuel for a violent move either way
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: A consumption business posting its strongest sequential dollar growth ever and 38% RPO growth usually beats its own sandbagged guide again -- SNOW printed +36% and +32.7% on the last two such setups, and a mildly positive score may understate that right tail
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Phase-0 history flagged as reversed (most recent print, +36% Q1 FY27, matches the list's first entry not its last). Could not source borrow cost, current options skew directly, or exact Q3 whisper

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% implied close to fair, marginally cheap; carries ±13-15% as the realistic distribution with a fat right tail given how binary this name has become. Direction close to a coin flip; magnitude is the tradable part.
panel_verdicts.insider_signal: Insider file is clean: all selling is plan-based on pre-existing 10b5-1 plans (Slootman, Speiser, Dageville, Kleinerman), large in dollars only because the stock tripled, no discretionary sales or cluster anomaly. CEO Ramaswamy's only 2026 Form 4 activity is RSU tax-withholding, zero open-market sales, plus a fresh 1M-unit long-dated PSU grant -- conspicuously not selling into $323.
panel_verdicts.communication_signal: No hedging found -- Q1 FY27 raised FY27 product revenue and operating-margin guidance, disclosed NRR up to 126%, stacked a $6B AWS commitment and the Natoma acquisition; no KPI dropped, no pre-announcement, no August 8-K. Management booked three post-print investor-conference fireside chats a month in advance -- weak but real evidence against a team expecting to disappoint. One caution: management churn under the surface (CRO change, CFO only a year in, a director resignation).
key_drivers: Insider file clean and mildly bullish by omission -- no discretionary selling, CEO not selling into strength
Communication is confident, not hedged: guidance raised last quarter, no KPI redefinition or removal, heavy forward investor-conference calendar

Options tape leans bullish (2.57x calls) but downside skew widening underneath it -- hedging demand rising even as call buying continues; 35 Buy/3 Hold ratings with only ~7% target premium show a good print is already the consensus outcome
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The bar, not the business: with sell-side pre-positioned for a 300-400bp beat and targets only 7% above spot, an in-line-to-good print with a Q3 guide that merely re-supports FY27 reads as deceleration and could sell off hard regardless of the clean forensic read
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Borrow fee, dark-pool prints, and current web-traffic data unavailable; 10b5-1 plan adoptions this quarter unverified (plan dates from Form 4 footnotes only). Phase-0 history flagged as most-recent-first, not last -- not used in the call

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: No directional edge: individual personas split roughly 4 mildly bullish / 3 mildly bearish and net to a consensus of -1.0, essentially zero. The real finding is on magnitude, not direction -- five of seven personas independently judged the +-12% implied move cheap against SNOW's own 14-17% historical realised average, and the two nearest data-infrastructure comps (MongoDB, Datadog) both sold off on beat-and-raise days in the same week, a precedent several personas weighted heavily. Main caveat: this name has genuinely fat tails in both directions (max realised move 36.48%, two of the last three prints over 30%).
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: Red-team's own score (+10) does not oppose the panel's consensus so much as sit near it. Its 'strongest reversal case' is itself a bearish scenario -- a beat-and-raise that still reads as deceleration against SNOW's own accelerating Q1 base (34%->~30% guided growth), echoing the MongoDB and Datadog post-beat selloffs the macro/peers, options and sentiment personas converged on independently from different evidence. That cross-persona convergence on a 'good-number, bad-reaction' path is the more informative signal here than any single directional score, and it is reflected in the wide, cheap-priced magnitude band rather than in a directional call.
synthesis.data_caveat: Five of seven personas independently flagged that the supplied historical_moves_pct list, though numerically correct, was mislabelled as ordered most-recent-last -- OptionSlam and company filings place the +36.48% print (not the -14.7% one) as the most recent (2026-05-27 Q1 FY27). All personas caught this via their own sourcing and stated they did not let the mislabelled ordering affect their calls; the aggregate statistics (mean/median/max) synthesize.py uses are order-independent, so the synthesis is unaffected. Flagged here for the archive record.
